phrases.latin: ēlixat ōllīs et cacabīs in focō
phrases.english: he boils in pots and pans on the hearth

caccabus.against: Lewis & Short cācabus, taking the heavy first syllable for a long vowel
caccabus.html: Greek κάκκαβος. Varro writes caccabum (cited by Lewis & Short); Stat. Silv. 4.9.45, albōrum calicum atque caccabōrum, scans the first syllable heavy, as the double c makes it. Comenius’s cacabīs is marked the same way.

olla.html: The later form of aula: Festus, aulās antīquī dīcēbant, quās nōs dīcimus ōllās.
